description: On the yellow tabletop, there’s a small white open box or base in the center and a white bulb-shaped lamp piece off to the right, with a red cloth backdrop behind. The left hand steadies the white base near the center while the right hand reaches in from the right, grasps the bulb-shaped piece as a right-hand object, lifts it, moves it leftward over the base, and then lowers and aligns it onto the base as if assembling a lamp, while the left hand keeps the base from sliding.
